description: Search a supported Google surface via CrustAPI and get clean, structured JSON. Choose the surface with `type`: maps (local businesses with ratings/phone/website), places (lean local pack), news, shopping, images, scholar, patents, or autocomplete (query suggestions). Results come back in structured JSON. Empty results are free.

gl.description: Country code (us, gb, de, ...). Default us. Not used by maps.

limit.description: type=maps only: how many businesses to return (billed per returned business).

location.description: City/region for local results, e.g. 'Austin, TX'.

q.description: The search query, e.g. 'dentists in Miami'.

name: search

news.description: News articles with source, date, and image (news).

places.description: Businesses with ratings, phone, website (maps, places).

searchParameters.description: Echo of the query that was run.

title: Search Google Maps and other supported surfaces
